<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Two processes on the same state/action types agree pointwise on steps iff they agree on all finite labelled traces with both endpoints retained.

Canonical source: [Labelled.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Labelled.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Common State and Action types, supplied Process.step relations, and the existing Trace definition.

The actual interpretation of states, actions and steps remains supplied.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

Word feasibility alone loses law information; static and toggle processes supply the counterexample.

Boundary source: [DynamicConsequences.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/DynamicConsequences.lean)

<a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [finite-trace-transport](finite-trace-transport.md). Both directions use trace_map with the identity map; step recovery separately uses the existing singleton lemma.

**Output:** Target trace under a step-preserving map.

**Input:** The two SameSteps implications each supply hstep.

**Preserved conditions:** Same state/action types and endpoints; no physical law identification. [DynamicConsequences.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/DynamicConsequences.lean)
